blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu animal welfare advocates are seeking investigations into the reported euthanasia of healthy dogs and alleged neglect in government pounds, urging provincial officials to inspect facilities and account for the implementation of existing animal welfare measures. In a letter dated Oct. 21, 2026, Cebu Rescue Network (CRN) asked Gov. Pamela Baricuatro and Dr. Mary Rose Vincoy, the provincial veterinarian, to provide an update on the province’s animal welfare initiatives and address reported problems in several local government units (LGUs). The appeal followed the first meeting of the Provincial Animal Welfare Council (PAWC) at the Capitol on Oct. […]...
